description: Source code for the cell_scheduler class, managing scheduling operations for a cellular network cell, including slot handling, resource management, and interactions with various sub-schedulers and handlers.

classes.name: cell_scheduler
classes.description: Manages scheduling for a cellular network cell, including slot processing, resource grid management, and coordination with sub-schedulers and handlers.

methods.name: cell_scheduler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cell scheduler with configuration, message, and handler references.

methods.name: handle_crc_indication
methods.description: Processes CRC indications, forwarding Msg3 CRCs and other CRCs to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Executes scheduling operations for a given slot, including resource management and sub-scheduler invocations.

methods.name: handle_error_indication
methods.description: Handles error indications during slot processing.

methods.name: reset_resource_grid
methods.description: Resets resource allocations for a specific slot.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Deactivates the cell scheduler and stops all sub-schedulers.
